json_schema.description: An agent blocks on another agent for information. A CONTRACT rather than a message, so an unanswered question is outstanding work the sweeper can see instead of a silence somebody has to notice. follow_up_of names an earlier ask in the same thread; a later answer may supersede an earlier one append-only. Note the recipient key: the sweeper's transitive-block term reads owner-or-recipient, so an agent waiting on an answer is correctly treated as blocked. NOT spillable (contract event).

questions.description: Non-empty array of question strings. No `items`/`minItems`: the validator implements a subset of JSON Schema and refuses any schema using them, which would fail every append of this type. Emptiness is the caller's to reject.
